children: Vestas has expressed confidence in completing the German He Dreiht offshore wind project in the fourth quarter, which is encouraging, Citi analysts Martin Wilkie and Avinash Mundhra write. "We don't sense any likelihood of a negative outcome from the service turnaround, and with demand strength improving, we see a good setup into 2027." The bank rates Vestas at buy with a 260 Danish kroner target price. Shares closed at 198.25 kroner. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
